lines.t: (Verse 1)
Door shut tight, wrapped myself in a blanket
Thought I was fine, but I was breaking
Silent prayers I wouldn’t say out loud
Still You heard me somehow
Lights off, heart on the floor
I said I didn’t need You anymore
But even in the mess I made
Your love never moved away
(Chorus)
You never left the room
Even when I closed the door
You were right there with me
Like You were there before
I tried to hide, but You stayed
I tried to run, but You remained
Love like this won’t let go
I’m never alone
You never left the room
You never left the room
(Verse 2)
Closed the door, shut the window tight
Thought I could disappear that night
But even in the dark, You stayed
Love wouldn’t walk away
When I put my head on my pillow and cried
You comforted me every time
Even when I did wrong, You stayed
Corrected me with the love You gave
(Chorus)
You never left the room
Even when I closed the door
You were right there with me
Like You were there before
I tried to hide, but You stayed
I tried to run, but You remained
Love like this won’t let go
I’m never alone
You never left the room
You never left the room
(Bridge (Hook)
You never left
You never left
You were there
Every step
Even when I did wrong, You stayed
Corrected me with the love You gave
You never walked away from me
You never stopped loving me
(Final Chorus / Outro)
You never left the room
Even when I closed the door
You were right there with me
Like You were there before
I’m done running, I’m done hiding too
Now I’m running back to You
Every breath I know it’s true
You never left the room
You never left the room
